title: Settings
profileNote: These apply to the profile "{name}", and to it on every device you are signed in on.
profileNoteUnnamed: These apply to the profile you have open.

enableDragAndDrop.title: Enable drag & drop
enableDragAndDrop.explanation: Drag a link to reorder it, into a subgroup or into another group; drag a group to move it along the row.

hideTips.title: Hide tips
hideTips.explanation: Stop showing the tips along the bottom of the page. This is where they come back from.

theme.title: Theme
theme.explanation: Whether the page is drawn light or dark. "Follow the system" switches along with your operating system's setting. Kept on this device only.

uiScale.title: Size
uiScale.explanation: How big everything is drawn. This one is kept on this device only - a desktop and a laptop want different answers, and one should not decide for the other.

closedTabsOpenDelay.title: Recently closed tabs: opening delay
closedTabsOpenDelay.explanation: How long the pointer has to rest on the recently closed tabs rail before it opens, so that passing over it on the way to the menu does not. Kept on this device only.

language.title: Language
language.explanation: What this extension speaks. "Follow the browser" uses your browser's own language, and falls back to English where this extension has no translation. Kept on this device only.

dateFormat.title: Date format
dateFormat.explanation: How dates are written. "Local custom" writes them the way your browser's region does. Kept on this device only.

searchEngine.title: Search engine
searchEngine.explanation: Where the search bar at the top of the page sends what you type. "Default search engine" is the one your browser is set to, and is used until you choose another - here or with the icon beside the bar. Kept on this device only.

backgroundImage.title: Background
backgroundImage.explanation: Choose a picture to put behind the page, or add one of your own. Pictures are kept on this device only, and × takes one out of the list.
backgroundImage.failed: That file could not be used as a background. Try another picture.
backgroundImage.downloadFailed: That picture could not be downloaded. Check the connection and try again.
backgroundImage.noRoom: This picture could not be kept: the browser has no more room for it. Remove some of your own pictures from the list and try again.

bookmarkShortcut.title: Shortcut to save a page
bookmarkShortcut.explanation: The keys that save the page you are on into Tabilinks. Chrome lets you change them only on its own shortcuts page - set Ctrl+D there and it saves here instead of into Chrome's bookmarks.

recordClosedTabs.title: Record closed tabs
recordClosedTabs.explanation: Keep a list of the tabs you close in the panel on the right, synced to every device of this profile when you are signed in. Turning it off deletes the list.

confirmOff.title: Stop recording closed tabs?
confirmOff.message: The list of closed tabs is deleted from this profile, on every device you are signed in on, and no more tabs are recorded until you turn it back on. Links you have already saved stay.

recordBrowsingHistory.title: Record browsing history
recordBrowsingHistory.explanation: Keep a list of the pages you visit in the panel on the right - the most recent 50, or 1000 with premium - synced to every device of this profile when you are signed in. Off by default. Turning it off deletes the history.

confirmOff.title: Stop recording browsing history?
confirmOff.message: The browsing history is deleted from this profile, on every device you are signed in on, and no more pages are recorded until you turn it back on. Links you have already saved stay.

keepSidePanelOpen.title: Keep the side panel open
keepSidePanelOpen.explanation: The panel of open tabs, closed tabs and history stays open beside the columns instead of widening under the pointer. On this device only.

closeSidePanelOnClick.title: Closing the side panel takes a click
closeSidePanelOnClick.explanation: Once the pointer has opened the panel, it stays open when the pointer moves away, until you open something in it or click outside it. On this device only.

syncEnabled.title: Synchronise this browser
syncEnabled.explanation: While you are signed in, this browser's links, settings and the logs below are synchronised with your account. Off, you stay signed in and keep premium, but nothing is sent or received. On this device only.
syncEnabled.offBlocksLogs: This browser does not synchronise. Turn on "Synchronise this browser" first.

syncClosedTabs.title: Synchronise closed tabs
syncClosedTabs.explanation: Share this browser's recently closed tabs with your other devices, and see theirs. Off, the list stays on this browser alone. On this device only.
syncClosedTabs.notRecorded: Closed tabs are not recorded for this profile, so there is nothing to synchronise.

syncBrowsingHistory.title: Synchronise browsing history
syncBrowsingHistory.explanation: Share this browser's browsing history with your other devices, and see theirs. Off, the history stays on this browser alone. On this device only.
syncBrowsingHistory.notRecorded: Browsing history is not recorded for this profile, so there is nothing to synchronise.

themeStyle.title: Theme style
themeStyle.explanation: Flat draws groups and menus solid. Aero - the default - makes them partly transparent and blurs what is behind them, best with a background picture. Kept on this device only.
